name: Ugin
aliases: the beating heart of the world
description: Ugin is an unfathomably old spirit dragon and planeswalker, twin brother of Nicol Bolas, known for devising the imprisonment of the Eldrazi on Zendikar and for his long rivalry with Bolas.

timeline.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir in search of the spirit dragon Ugin, led by an oracle's visions toward a dragon-head mountain peak.
timeline.quote: Somewhere up there was his destination.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin worries over Nahiri's silence and Ugin's absence while the Eldrazi titans rampage on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans were a fire that could not be quenched, and Ugin's absence was strange.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: The Temur guide tells Sorin that dragons have been hunted to extinction and that the Spirit Dragon gave the Temur magic to fight corrupted dragons.
timeline.quote: But some say that the dragons became greedy and corrupt, so the Spirit Dragon gave us magic to fight them.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: The guide leads Sorin to a chasm where only huge bones lie, and Sorin refuses to believe it is Ugin.
timeline.quote: That cannot be Ugin.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin descends into the chasm, finds Ugin's skull in the ice and discovers Ugin is dead.
timeline.quote: Ugin was dead. And with him fell the hopes of countless worlds.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls the name Ugin as the dragon he should have heeded, and hears a voice telling him to find the doorway.
timeline.quote: The world remembers what its people have forgotten.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset reads the Annals in the stronghold's depths, learning of clans working together against the dragons and of Ugin and Bolas, but cannot decipher Ugin's runes.
timeline.quote: I learned that a dragon named Ugin was connected to Tarkir in ways the khans couldn't comprehend, and that some had claimed Ugin was gone, but not dead.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin appears as a luminous dragon, and Nahiri meets him for the first time.
timeline.quote: Then he was there with them: a massive, ethereal dragon, shining with blue-white light.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he watched the destruction without helping, in order to learn about the Eldrazi, and explains what they are and why they cannot simply be killed.
timeline.quote: They're called the Eldrazi," said Ugin, "and they devour entire worlds.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin proposes imprisoning the three true Eldrazi on a single plane, binding them with physical anchors and forcing them into dormancy.
timeline.quote: Bind them to one plane using their physical forms as anchors, and force them into dormancy.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin describes the ideal prison world, and Nahiri realizes he means Zendikar, refusing at first.
timeline.quote: What gives me the right to put everyone here in danger?

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains he chose Zendikar because it has a protector, and asks for Nahiri's help rather than forcing her.
timeline.quote: No," said Ugin. "Because I also need your help.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri decides that Zendikar will be the Eldrazi's prison and she their jailer, and agrees to the plan.
timeline.quote: Zendikar would be their prison, Nahiri their jailer, one world and one Planeswalker standing steadfast to protect all others.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Over forty years, Nahiri pulls hedrons from the earth and Ugin etches them with runes, creating a trap and a lure for the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It took forty years of near-constant work.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin focus their power in the Eye of Ugin and shift every hedron into its final position, completing the network.
timeline.quote: Every single hedron on the plane glowed as they shifted into new positions.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges in darkness on a snowy Temur tundra after passing through the flaming gate, with the gate gone and Ugin's voice silent.
timeline.quote: But now he was standing still in the darkness in the middle of a vast, snowy Temur tundra.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan grieves that Narset died and cries out to Ugin, realizing the voice in his head is gone.
timeline.quote: The ceaseless whispering, the constant flow of Ugin's words in his head—the voice was gone!

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan falls to his knees, begging Ugin to speak, then laughs hysterically at the irony of wanting the whispers back.
timeline.quote: You can't be silent now!

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Over millennia, Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon revered by a clan.
timeline.quote: Over the millennia, the spirit dragon Ugin's magic coalesced into powerful storms on his native plane of Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas and Ugin, long-time rivals, finally clash in the sky above Tarkir, and Sarkhan arrives to watch.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas and Ugin—two of the most powerful Planeswalkers the Multiverse has ever known—finally clashed in the sky above Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the whispers in his head were Ugin's plea leading him across time, and that his choice will reforge Tarkir's fate.
timeline.quote: they were a plea from Ugin that had led Sarkhan across time to this place and this moment.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova questions Sarkhan, who says he follows the whispers of Ugin and thinks she may be his spirit guide.
timeline.quote: I seek the great dragon Ugin.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan tells Yasova that in his homeland there are no dragons or dragon tempests, only bones, and that Ugin is long dead.
timeline.quote: Not in all of Tarkir," he said. "Only bones.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova confirms that she believes the dragons fall if Ugin dies, and Sarkhan realizes a storm guided him to her.
timeline.quote: If Ugin dies, the storms cease. The dragons fall.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova reveals that a great golden dragon appeared in her vision and asked her to chart the storms so that he could find and kill Ugin.
timeline.quote: He told me that if I showed him the way to the spirit dragon's lair…he would kill Ugin.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon, breathes fire to push Yasova aside rather than fight, and flies off to protect Ugin.
timeline.quote: With a kick from his powerful legs, Sarkhan Vol launched himself into the sky.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova confesses that she helped a malevolent dragon spirit attack Ugin in hopes of ending the storms.
timeline.quote: I saw that the storms would cease if I helped a malevolent dragon spirit kill the great Ugin.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that the sar-khan encased Ugin in a stone cocoon after she healed him, causing the tempests to return fourfold.
timeline.quote: He encased Ugin in a great stone cocoon inscribed with draconic runes.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The khans disagree over whether to open the cocoon, kill Ugin, or kill the brood-lords; Shu Yun insists on balance and seeking Ugin.
timeline.quote: The destruction of the dragons is no better than the destruction of the clans.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan is pulled back through time and finds himself before the weathered hedron cocoon, evidence that many years have passed.
timeline.quote: He was standing before the hedron cocoon, exactly where he had been a mere moment before

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Taigam throws Sarkhan down the stairs; Sarkhan flies off in despair, resolving to wake Ugin to repair the timeline.
timeline.quote: It was time to wake the Spirit Dragon.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset searches archives under Cori Mountain and Riverwheel and learns of Ugin and the dragon tempests.
timeline.quote: She learned of a Spirit Dragon, Ugin, who was the source of all magic on the plane, as well as the dragon tempests.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir, uneasy beneath the sun, searching for Ugin who may be dead and guided only by an oracle's vague visions.
timeline.quote: His only guide now was a cluster of vague impressions given to him by an oracle.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin enthralls a warrior as a guide and learns from him that the khans fell, the dragons now rule, and Ugin dwells in the Haven.
timeline.quote: Ugin is the beating heart of the world. He dwells within the Haven.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin drains the thrall of what blood remains and uses blood magic to destroy the hedron shard and unmake the cocoon, freeing Ugin.
timeline.quote: The hedron shard crumbled to dust, and the cocoon began to crack.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explodes from the ruins, recognizes Sorin, and says he was saved after Bolas attacked him using his own dragons.
timeline.quote: He thought me his rival for power, and attacked me. Used my own dragons against me.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Ugin that over a thousand years have passed and the Eldrazi have escaped their hedron prison on Zendikar, partly through Nissa's choice.
timeline.quote: They're free." Sorin had the urge to press the matter, to needle Ugin, to make someone else shoulder the blame.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin asks about Nahiri, and Sorin evasively says she lives but is not on Zendikar; Ugin insists all three of them must work together.
timeline.quote: Let me be clear. It must be the three of us.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin agrees to join Sorin at the Eye of Ugin, and Sorin planeswalks away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will join you at the Eye soon.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan reflects, in flight, that everyone he knew lives changed, except himself and Narset, and resolves to ask Ugin.
timeline.quote: Everyone lived, it seemed, save two. Sarkhan. And Narset.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees blue-white light rise from Ugin's canyon and is harried by ghostly dragons that then retreat.
timeline.quote: Soon the spirit was joined by others.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds the hedron cocoon crumbled and Ugin alive, projecting images of Tarkir's dragons on the canyon wall.
timeline.quote: There, at the end of the canyon, a luminous shape towered, wings outstretched.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin deduces from the hedron shard that it came from the Eye after his defeat, and asks who Sarkhan is.
timeline.quote: I'm applying logic.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan explains his history: Ugin's spirit whispered to him, Bolas sent him to the Eye, and he later traveled back in time to save Ugin.
timeline.quote: When I stepped through I traveled back, before the dragons died, and tipped the scales of history.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan names Bolas as the one who sent him to the Eye to release the Eldrazi, and Ugin contains him briefly in a sphere of force before releasing him.
timeline.quote: He wanted it opened, the devourers released. He never told me why.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that Sarkhan's original Tarkir never existed, and that Sarkhan never was born in this history.
timeline.quote: you, Sarkhan Vol, stepped fully formed out of a shadow, a place that never existed.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin recounts that Sorin Markov woke him and spoke of foolishness at the Eye.
timeline.quote: An ally of mine, a vampire and a Planeswalker, woke me up and spoke to me of 'foolishness at the Eye.'

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan thanks Ugin and flies off to find Narset, certain she lives again.
timeline.quote: I say she lives again, and I will find her.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset reveals she traveled beyond Tarkir; Sarkhan explains planeswalkers and that three are in the valley.
timeline.quote: Planeswalker," said Sarkhan. "That's what we're called.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset goes to speak to Ugin and plans to study Atarka's ivory histories, content to stay on Tarkir for now; Sarkhan agrees.
timeline.quote: But this world has secrets enough. For right now…I'm right where I want to be.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan arrives on Tarkir, recalls his past and the ghost of Ugin urges him to find the doorway; he sets out for the mountains.
timeline.quote: who urges him to "find the doorway."

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin fights through Temur hunters, makes a vampire guide and finds Ugin dead in the canyon, concluding the Multiverse is doomed.
timeline.quote: Ugin is long since dead, and Sorin concludes that the Multiverse is doomed.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Six thousand years earlier, Nahiri and Sorin fail to save an unknown plane from the Eldrazi, then agree with Ugin to imprison the titans on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The trap is sprung, the titans are subdued, and Nahiri settles in for a long vigil to keep them imprisoned.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Bolas strikes down Ugin, Sarkhan wraps Ugin in a hedron cocoon, and is whisked back to an altered present; the dragon tempests intensify.
timeline.quote: Bolas strikes Ugin down as Sarkhan tumbles into the snow.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin, with no memory of an earlier visit, destroys the cocoon and awakens Ugin, who tells him the Eldrazi are free.
timeline.quote: Sorin destroys the cocoon and awakens Ugin.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin insists it must be the three of them, and Sorin agrees to find Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Reluctantly, Sorin agrees to seek out Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar to stop the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds Ugin awake, learns he was never born in this timeline, and finds Narset, a Planeswalker exile; both are content to remain on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: both Planeswalkers agree that they are exactly where they wish to be.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri frees herself from her cocoon, goes to the great hedron, and sends a summons to Sorin and the Spirit Dragon.
timeline.quote: she sent her call into the Æther

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: After waiting, Nahiri realizes Sorin and the Spirit Dragon have not come and she is alone.
timeline.quote: They hadn't come. Sorin hadn't come. She was alone.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: A dragon unfolds from the shadows; Jace fears it is Bolas, but it introduces itself as Ugin, builder of the Eye.
timeline.quote: My name is Ugin. I helped build this place, long ago.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he knows Jace was one of three planeswalkers who opened the Eye, manipulated by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: You, a pyromancer, and a dragonspeaker. Planeswalkers all. You opened the Eye.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Ugin that Ulamog is headed for Sea Gate, and Ugin shows he does not know the city, having been away for ages.
timeline.quote: I was detained. Sea Gate?

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace that Ulamog cannot be killed and proposes imprisoning the Eldrazi again with the help of his allies.
timeline.quote: You cannot kill Ulamog,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace and Ugin argue over whether the hedrons can be relied on again, and Ugin insists the earlier release was orchestrated.
timeline.quote: It was not an accident,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin conjures an illusion of the hedron network as it was, how it drifted without the Lithomancer, and how it stands now, shattered.
timeline.quote: The hedron network as it stands,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace counters Ugin's illusion with scenes of Sea Gate and of Zendikar's suffering people, insisting Zendikar is somebody's home.
timeline.quote: Zendikar isn't a puzzle to be solved,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin says he is here to save the Multiverse, not the people of Zendikar.
timeline.quote: With the Eldrazi at large, the entire Multiverse is at risk.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace commits to helping, and Ugin asks him to find Sorin Markov, whom he warns not to trust, or else Nahiri.
timeline.quote: If you want to help, then seek him out, bring him here, but . . . do not trust him.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi titans dwell in the Blind Eternities and what Jace sees is a projection, so killing them would only free them.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans do not dwell in physical space,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi brood are connected to the titans like cells or organs, so killing them achieves nothing.
timeline.quote: More like cells,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin orders Jace to dissuade his friends from attacking Ulamog and to stop them if necessary, so Ulamog is not driven from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You must dissuade your friends from attacking Ulamog directly

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
timeline.quote: The Planeswalkers' trap worked.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A little over a thousand years ago the Eldrazi nearly escape and Nahiri restores their prison alone, then goes to check on her absent allies and is not seen again.
timeline.quote: Nahiri restored the Eldrazi's prison on her own

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace, guided by Jori En, meets Ugin at the Eye, learns how hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi and decides to ignore Ugin's warnings.
timeline.quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye and made his way to Sea Gate

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace suggests leaving Zendikar to its fate, and Nissa refuses and the ground trembles.
timeline.quote: I'm not going anywhere,

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace presents half a plan with the glyph that Ugin showed him, since a hedron trap for two titans is impossible.
timeline.quote: It's no longer possible to trap Kozilek and Ulamog,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace announces that since they cannot trap the titans nor let them leave, they will kill them, revealing Ugin's warning he had promised to heed.
timeline.quote: We're going to kill them.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains Ugin's metaphor and concludes the titans can be pulled fully into the physical world to be killed.
timeline.quote: we pull the two titans into the physical world completely, and then we can kill them.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Ugin lands furiously among the Zendikari, demanding to know what Jace has done.
timeline.quote: What have you done?

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains the plan and Ugin reveals that Emrakul is gone from Zendikar and that he knew the titans could be killed.
timeline.quote: Emrakul is gone, and has been for some time.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
timeline.quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Ugin departs, and Jace and Gideon decide that Jace will go to Innistrad to find Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: I'll go to Innistrad and find Sorin.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri says the Eldrazi broke free of their bonds and she resealed their prison alone.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she resealed the Eldrazi prison alone after neither he nor Ugin answered her signal.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Recounted: Nahiri stood watch over the imprisoned Eldrazi for five thousand years, then fought them off alone when they escaped.
timeline.quote: For five thousand years, Nahiri stood watch over their monstrous prisoners.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Nahiri he owes her nothing and that he molded her, telling her to bother Ugin instead.
timeline.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri declares she is done being a warden and that Zendikar will never again be a prison, so Emrakul had to go somewhere.
timeline.quote: I'm done being a warden, and Zendikar will never again be a prison.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace recalls Ugin bidding him farewell (memory).
timeline.quote: Good fortune, Jace Beleren

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the memory of Ugin hides a spell that compelled him to planeswalk to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: a clever bit of obfuscating mental magic that the spirit dragon must have implanted without him noticing.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin arrives on Azor's newest plane, welcomed by crowds, to meet his associate.
timeline.quote: His name was Ugin, and his purpose was, and always had been, singular.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Azor he has a plan to free the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Together we will rid the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor outlines creating the Immortal Sun on Ixalan to summon Bolas, at the cost of his spark.
timeline.quote: I will build the Immortal Sun there, on the continent of Torrezon.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin says he will lure Bolas to Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will lure him to Tarkir.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: On another plane Bolas absorbs a lawmage's mind, learning of the plot and killing her.
timeline.quote: listening to him and the Spirit Dragon plot the end of the True Evil

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas appears before Ugin on Tarkir, having followed Azor's clues.
timeline.quote: when his nemesis appeared before him

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas mocks Azor's statues as the reason he was found.
timeline.quote: Your idiot cat is too fond of statues of himself,

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas overpowers Ugin with a swarm of dragon eyes and attackers.
timeline.quote: The Spirit Dragon tried to escape, but was caught in a tempest of fire and claws.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: A man out of time preserves Ugin's body in a cocoon of stone.
timeline.quote: That man preserved Ugin's body in a cocoon of stone and vanished.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor waits in vain for Ugin's signal, left without a spark and a prisoner.
timeline.quote: Azor was left without a spark, and his prison without a prisoner.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The last egg-stone unfurls into twin dragons, Nicol and Ugin, who crash through the canopy; Nicol is pinned by a tree trunk.
timeline.quote: You're Nicol, aren't you? That's your name.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Hunters work together to net and kill Merrevia Sal while Nicol, pinned, wants to help but Ugin holds him back.
timeline.quote: Yet still she struggles, still she fights because she is a dragon, and dragons never bow before lesser creatures.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin clamps Nicol's muzzle to hush him as Merrevia is hunted into the trees and dies.
timeline.quote: Ugin clamps talons over his muzzle, smothering him.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol is freed and finds the clearing too late; he wants revenge but Ugin urges finding their siblings first.
timeline.quote: We must find the others first. Safety in numbers, as the hunters had.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol rips off a dog's head and flies awkwardly to the peak with Ugin.
timeline.quote: He leaps forward onto the lead dog and rips its head off with a single bite.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: From the peak Nicol sees the bodies of weak dragons and decides being the hunter is better, while Ugin stares at the sky and asks where they came from.
timeline.quote: Dying isn't wonderful. It's bad. But being the hunter: that's a better thing.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision Ugin calls Yasova Dragonclaw to come to him.
timeline.quote: Someone is looking for you, Yasova Dragonclaw. Come to me.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya explains the vision came from Ugin and they must go to his grave.
timeline.quote: That's why we have to go to Ugin's grave.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin explains his master's dream and that Ojutai destroyed records but the Spirit Dragon's story survives by oral tradition.
timeline.quote: He wants to destroy our memory of the past, and of our ancestors

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin recites the words of Ugin, who says the one he loved best in all the worlds is the one who killed him.
timeline.quote: The one I loved best in all the worlds is the one who killed me.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback in Ugin's words: he and Nicol learn that no creature is safe after witnessing their sister's death and set out to find their siblings.
timeline.quote: We witnessed the death of a sister, and in this way, we learned that no creature is safe.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol insists they should have interfered to stop the hunters and wants to learn how to destroy them.
timeline.quote: I want to know who those hunters are, and where they come from, and how we can destroy them.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins meet Chromium Rhuell by a lake, who dismisses them and sends them to Palladia-Mors.
timeline.quote: But for now, go away, little ones.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Palladia-Mors scorns the twins as runts and flings a corpse at them.
timeline.quote: You're so small, the two of you. Little runts.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin sees nothing wasted in the cycle of life and death, while Nicol wants to kill something.
timeline.quote: I want to kill something,

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins spend years perfecting tandem hunting, and meet Vaevictis Asmadi's territory.
timeline.quote: We spent years, as you Jeskai would measure the span of days, perfecting various techniques for hunting in tandem.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins find Arcades Sabboth ruling a human settlement.
timeline.quote: To our surprise our sibling Arcades Sabboth had taken up residence inside the great ring wall.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol burns a tower and soldiers when humans shoot at the twins, and Arcades slams into him.
timeline.quote: His blast of fire breath scorched along the highest tower and its adjoining wall walk.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol takes the name Nicol Bolas and the twins are admitted to the colony as Arcades's guests.
timeline.quote: I am Nicol Bolas,

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins live for years in the colony, Ugin befriending the holy elder Te Ju Ki.
timeline.quote: I poked my snout into everything, and made particular friends with an old holy elder named Te Ju Ki

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Te Ju Ki shows Ugin globes of light she calls planes and teaches that death is part of endless cycles.
timeline.quote: She called each one a "plane," although I did not know what she meant by the word at that time.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: one man stabs his brother in a sudden quarrel after years of peace, and Nicol watches with satisfaction.
timeline.quote: Nicol lounged there, stretched along the ridgeline, watching the scene with an avid gaze.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol tells Ugin he has found a better way to avenge their sister and flies off without farewells.
timeline.quote: I have discovered a better way to get revenge.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Arcades dismisses Ugin's concerns, and Ugin leaves Te Ju Ki to follow Nicol.
timeline.quote: I know where he's going. I must follow him.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback in Ugin's words: Ugin flies alone back across the land toward the birth mountain, finding solitude difficult and learning that all things breathe.
timeline.quote: But slowly as I flew and hunted my way back across the wide, wild land, I began to hear how all things breathe.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin finds Vaevictis Asmadi and his siblings chasing Nicol while burning human settlements.
timeline.quote: They were chasing a dragon.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin frightens Vaevictis off with spun globes of light so Nicol can escape.
timeline.quote: So, I reached into my tiny arsenal of magical tricks and spun a pair of transparent, feather-light globes out of the nexus of colors and into the air.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol reunites with Ugin and mocks Te Ju Ki, claiming no human can be as wise as the youngest dragon.
timeline.quote: No human, however old, can ever be as wise as the youngest dragon

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol tells Ugin of other lands across the ocean and refuses to consider that other dragons may be older.
timeline.quote: We are the first, after all, and thus the most powerful.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Palladia-Mors steals the twins' kills and warns them that humans near the birth mountain think they are dragon hunters.
timeline.quote: Those humans have gotten above themselves and think they are dragon hunters.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins reach the birth mountain and find human settlements with dragon skulls and carved gates showing dragons being killed.
timeline.quote: They have turned our sister into an ornament!

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: humans fire poisoned bolts, wounding Ugin, and fight to bathe in his fallen blood.
timeline.quote: Although Nicol twisted out of their way, my left rear claw was cut by a glancing blow.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin lands on the mountain's rim and Nicol vows to avenge their sister, claiming a cunning plan that needs no killing.
timeline.quote: I have a plan, a very cunning plan, because I have taught myself to do something no one else can do.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin says his master believes some essence of Ugin endures and reached out, which is why he was sent.
timeline.quote: The tempests that birth dragons have increased in strength since Ugin's death.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin and Nicol wait on the birth mountain overnight and see a lone traveler who proves to be Chromium Rhuell in human form.
timeline.quote: who appeared outwardly as a pregnant human except for the way his eyes shone like sapphires

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell describes the dragon-killing chief and his heirs and proposes destroying them; Nicol twists his words.
timeline.quote: My recommendation is that we destroy the chief, his heirs, and his acolytes, burn all the temples, and salt the fields.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell, enraged by Nicol's twisting of words, reveals his true dragon form, belittles Nicol as the least of them, and flies away.
timeline.quote: You are the least of us, last fallen, not even a whole dragon but only half of one, bound as you are to Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The twins watch the chief's procession and temple; Ugin hears whispers about the heirs' rivalry.
timeline.quote: She intends to outlast you and have you throttled when he dies.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol identifies the chief's attendants as two of his four heirs and says it will be easy.
timeline.quote: Those two who attend him so assiduously are two of his heirs.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol kills a young messenger to stop word reaching the other heirs.
timeline.quote: he swooped down, caught up the youth in his claws and, as the young human screamed and struggled, bit off his head.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol whispers into the mind of the chief's son at a lakeside settlement, persuading him to march against the other heirs and kill his father.
timeline.quote: It could be your measure. If you march against the other heirs.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol marks the longhouse ridge and the son's warriors march off; Nicol explains humans are easy to manipulate through hate, envy and fear.
timeline.quote: Humans are riddled with hate and envy and fear and greed.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin realizes Nicol caused the earlier murder and plans to manipulate his mind too, and he feels his twin's betrayal.
timeline.quote: He wanted to use me for his own ends, because he had never truly cared for me at all.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin is torn into the space between planes and then lands on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: being torn from the only place I had never known and flung into the space between the planes.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin ends his story, and Yasova says she witnessed Ugin's death eighteen years ago and another dragon who vanished in golden light.
timeline.quote: Eighteen years ago, I witnessed a battle in the sky that ended with the death of Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova reveals Bolas killed Ugin and that she was used as a tool, and that hedrons cast by Sarkhan Vol preserved some essence of Ugin.
timeline.quote: That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: In the story, the young dragon king Nicol sets the human heirs against each other, loses his brother Ugin to a blast of sorcery, and rules as a just king.
timeline.quote: In the course of the war, his brother was swept away into nothingness by a blast of human sorcery

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The king retreats into a canyon with a third of his army and plans a trap, thinking of Ugin and his search for a disintegration spell.
timeline.quote: For generations he had toiled in concert with his academy of sorcerers to recover or devise a magic that could replicate Ugin's disappearance.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova's party reaches the gateway to Ugin's grave, where hedrons cover the Spirit Dragon's bones, and Yasova calls for the group that camps there.
timeline.quote: Grandmother calls them hedrons. They protect the Spirit Dragon's bones.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya, saying Ugin is calling her, slips through a narrow cleft and Naiva follows, resisting a whisper telling her to abandon her twin.
timeline.quote: No. Death is more complicated than that. If you won't come, I'm going alone.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva and Baishya fall into Ugin's memories by touching hands inside the hedron.
timeline.quote: The magic of the hedrons opened a gate mind to mind.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin hovers above still waters between planes, realizing he has walked between worlds, then arrives on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: This must be one of the planes of which Te Ju Ki speaks.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin shifts back to Dominaria and finds the birth mountain now holds a city and temple with curved horns, which tells him Nicol rules there.
timeline.quote: He recognizes the shape of the curved horns.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin travels among many planes, then decides to find Nicol again, having mastered planeswalking.
timeline.quote: By now, he has mastered planeswalking.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin appears between the warring armies of Nicol and Arcades on Jamuraa and demands they stop.
timeline.quote: Nicol! Arcades! You must put a stop to this! It's wrong!

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol, thinking Ugin dead, blasts him with fire before Ugin convinces him; Nicol leaves his army to take Ugin to his domain.
timeline.quote: It will be. Come see what I have accomplished. Come, Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin confronts Nicol atop the birth mountain about his mind-manipulation and the pointlessness of his conquests.
timeline.quote: You tried to influence me with that trick of the mind.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he is a planeswalker, and Nicol asks to be taught.
timeline.quote: I am a Planeswalker now.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin cannot explain the spark; Nicol calls him a liar and a coward, and Ugin leaves in fury and grief.
timeline.quote: You can't tell me, can you?

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva wakes inside the hedron, and Yasova arrives and says Ugin is not dead but trying to communicate through dreams.
timeline.quote: It seems Ugin is not dead after all. But not awake either.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas says he wants Ugin, admits he killed him once before, and tries to enlist Naiva to destroy him for all eternity.
timeline.quote: That's what I thought the first time I killed him, but he wasn't dead after all.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers Naiva rule of the world if she tells him where Ugin is, and Naiva asks why he hates his twin.
timeline.quote: Why do you hate Ugin? He's your twin.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas denies that Ugin is his twin, calling it a story Ugin spread to share his glory.
timeline.quote: That's just a story he put about, trying to grab for a share of my glory and my triumph.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas begins his account, claiming he woke first and woke Ugin, who flew only because he taught him.
timeline.quote: In this way he discovered flight or, I should say, I taught him that flight is what we dragons are made for.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he avenged his sister's death on the humans while Ugin lost his nerve, then Ugin fled, vanishing.
timeline.quote: And so, he fled. He vanished, there one moment and then as if with the blink of the eye and a ripple through the air . . . GONE.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he killed the sorcerers around him and founded academies, then fought wars with his siblings until Arcades retreated and Ugin returned in the middle of the final battle.
timeline.quote: One day, when I had finally driven that stubborn tyrant Arcades into retreat, Ugin returned.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas says Ugin mocked him atop the birth mountain and vanished, and Bolas felt rage and envy.
timeline.quote: In a ripple of warm wind, he was gone.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he visited hundreds of worlds, found no other planeswalker, and returned home to share this with Ugin.
timeline.quote: I was the first among all sapient creatures to discover the possibility of traveling between planes.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he found Ugin floating in the Meditation Realm and that Ugin attacked him, leading to a long struggle across the planes.
timeline.quote: He attacked, viciously and without warning, all raw fury and malignant resentment.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he killed Ugin in the Meditation Realm in self-defense, and the shockwaves hurled him back to Dominaria on Madara.
timeline.quote: There, purely in self-defense, I killed him.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas threatens Naiva, tells her Ugin plagued him later with a plan to trap him on Ixalan, and learns she says Ugin's bones lie beneath the hedrons.
timeline.quote: He has plagued me ever since, most recently with a misbegotten plan to trap me on Ixalan by means of a magical artifact.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova confesses she helped Bolas track Ugin and cast a spell that turned fledgling dragons against him, after being promised an end to dragons.
timeline.quote: I helped Bolas track down Ugin because he promised me an end to dragons on Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova argues that destroying the hedrons would destroy Ugin's essence, the soul of Tarkir, so they must resist Bolas.
timeline.quote: I do not believe Bolas can destroy the hedrons.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva takes Baishya's hand and enters Ugin's memories in the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: After a decisive nod at Grandmother, she took hold of Baishya's hand.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin, in the Meditation Realm, regrets that Nicol was not overjoyed at his return and wonders whether his departure was his fault.
timeline.quote: Nicol had succumbed to the worst in himself

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas attacks Ugin in the Meditation Realm, accusing him of hoarding the planes' knowledge and abandoning him.
timeline.quote: You hoarded the knowledge of the planes to yourself.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin flees through Zendikar, Kephalai and Ravnica with Bolas in pursuit, wounded by his venomous magic.
timeline.quote: From bustling Kephalai to growing Ravnica and on and on, he flees with Nicol breathing down his neck

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin realizes Nicol will never stop unless he thinks him dead, and accepts death in the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: With a sigh, Ugin accepts his death. He lets go.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas kills Ugin, who falls into the waters; the cataclysm drains the realm and flings Bolas to Madara.
timeline.quote: With a mighty splash, Ugin falls into the still waters.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: The realm refills and a dragon, reborn from the waters, resolves to protect the planes and departs.
timeline.quote: Ugin has a lot to do if he means to protect the planes.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin asks a winged ally in a glass city for help to trap Bolas, planning to lure him to Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will lure him to Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas arrives on Tarkir and, turning the dragons against their progenitor, kills Ugin, who falls and carves the canyon.
timeline.quote: Bolas turns the dragons of Tarkir against their own progenitor

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that Bolas could not risk it being true, and Baishya says there really was a plot to trap Bolas, but Ugin died before activating it.
timeline.quote: There was a plot to trap Bolas using the Immortal Sun.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Narset theorizes that Ugin's departure unleashed the stronger storms, since he served as a metaphysical ballast.
timeline.quote: It has something to do with Ugin's departure, I am sure of it.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: At the Crucible Narset recalls the battle against the dragonlords on Shiko, and shows Elspeth the floating hedrons.
timeline.quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The realm reveals Ugin and a chained dragon together.
timeline.quote: revealing two figures that Narset would have known even in death

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin warns them away, and Bolas, who has lost his memories, says he recognizes the three and calls Jace an accomplice.
timeline.quote: That you, perhaps, were an accomplice

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that he has made the realm a prison for his brother, to be kept until Bolas dies millennia from now.
timeline.quote: So, I have made this our prison

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset asks Ugin for help against the dragonstorms and he says he cannot.
timeline.quote: I am sorry, but there is nothing I can do.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Bolas learns his name from Elspeth's argument and begins to remember.
timeline.quote: Is that my name?

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace, who has already shifted to an illusory double, seizes the gem between Ugin's horns and an explosion of light follows.
timeline.quote: Jace closed his hands over the gleaming jewel suspended between Ugin's horns

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Bolas laughs as his fetters come undone and he and Ugin vanish into the nothing as the Meditation Realm burns away.
timeline.quote: Bolas and Ugin winking out of existence, eaten by the nothing, dead now, perhaps.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin arrives and the wild dragons flee.
timeline.quote: The wild dragons simply fled, shrieking their terror

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin burns Sarkhan with ghostfire and Sarkhan dives away through the storm.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan screamed as it enveloped him.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin admits he has failed to keep his brother and that Bolas is free.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas, I am afraid, is free.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals that Jace had let Bolas be captured by Ugin and then Bolas escaped through an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: So Bolas escaped.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Jace shapes a body from the Meditation Realm, imitating Ugin, and pours his fractured selves into it.
timeline.quote: shaping a body from the inherent power of this place and pouring his fractured selves inside.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Disillusioned by Bolas, Sarkhan falls into madness and is led back to Tarkir by a voice he believes is Ugin's.
timeline.quote: Disillusioned by his servitude to the villainous, conniving, woefully undragonlike Bolas, Sarkhan fell into madness.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aided by Narset at the cost of her life, Sarkhan travels back through time to prevent Ugin's death at Bolas's hands.
timeline.quote: a way to travel back through time to the moment of Ugin's death at Nicol Bolas's hands and prevent the spirit dragon from falling.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Pulled back to the present, Sarkhan finds a world ruled by dragonlords where Ugin and Narset are still alive.
timeline.quote: a world in which both Ugin and Narset were still alive.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Tarkir of Sarkhan's birth is gone, and Sarkhan is now a man never born, with his mind free of Bolas and Ugin.
timeline.quote: his mind is once again his own, free of the influences of both Bolas and Ugin.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan travels back in time more than a thousand years and saves Ugin from death, ensuring the dragon tempests and thus dragons continue.
timeline.quote: he travelled back in time more than a thousand years to a crucial turning point, and there he saved Planeswalker Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, from death.

citation.text: "Tarkir". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Over his long life Ugin shapes entire planes, vanquishes cataclysmic forces and is reborn at least twice.
timeline.quote: Ugin has shaped entire planes, vanquished cataclysmic forces, and been reborn at least twice.

citation.text: "Ugin". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The ancient planeswalkers use the hedrons to lure, contain and immobilize the Eldrazi, who remain trapped for millennia.
timeline.quote: Unable to defeat the titans, the ancient Planeswalkers used the hedrons to lure, contain, and immobilize them.

citation.text: "Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Sorin calls Ugin his old ally; they sealed the Eldrazi together with the Lithomancer.
relations.quote: Sorin has found his way here, to Ugin's home world, in search of his old ally.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

relations.note: She agrees to work with Ugin to imprison the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Three of them, three of us. Together, we can save everything that is.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

relations.note: They have worked together in the past, though not recently.
relations.quote: We have worked amicably together in the past,

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

relations.note: Sarkhan has followed Ugin's whispers for years.
relations.quote: Sarkhan Vol has been following the voice in his head—the whispers of Ugin, the Spirit Dragon—for years now

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

relations.note: Rivals for eons who finally clash.
relations.quote: After a rivalry that spanned eons

relations.note: He saved Ugin from death at Bolas's hands.

relations.note: He saved Ugin and hopes Ugin will repair things.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

relations.note: He saved Ugin, who now questions him.
